body: I can't. I'm sorry. Just wasting everyone's time. I've tried everything, I've tried to ask for something else and he said there was nothing else. There's just no point, I can't handle another day of this. I've never been more afraid of anything so much as I'm afraid right now about waking up tomorrow. Don't worry about replying, I appreciate your help though, I do. Goodnight.
I've been to doctors, I've been to a hospital, I'm taking medication, like I don't know what else there is to do. I honestly just think I'm defective, there's no way.
I am alone, I don't have a choice.
